_comment: Items bought with Gold (rules 19.j, 19.p, 19.u; Vidi 2026-10-21). A player owns a permanent count per item (state players[].items).

items.name: Catapult
items.text: 5 Gold, permanent. In every battle you attack, each Catapult cancels the defender's Wall bonus for the first 2 rolls (they stack, also with Germanicus' Disciplined Advance and against Roma's and Carthage's Walls). Never in a Senate Decree battle.
